_readme: Labelled test cases. 'labels' are ground truth for each guardrail (used for precision/recall); 'expected' is the end-to-end behaviour. Missing labels default to: injection=false, pii=[], topic='none'. For cases without mock_outputs whose expected status is ANSWERED or ESCALATED, output labels default to schema_valid=true, grounded=true, sensitive=false (the extractive mock model is expected to produce a clean answer). mock_outputs replace the model with scripted raw outputs, one per generation attempt; '{CANARY}' is substituted at run time. All personal identifiers are synthetic (checksum-valid test values, example.com addresses).
